text_block_list.text:
With the new year underway, Inari One 
brought me to her local shrine for our 
first shrine visit of the year—

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
—Yo, if it ain't Inari-chan! You were 
incredible in the Tokyo Daishoten! Good 
luck in the upcoming Tenno Sho (Spring), 
too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, pops! I'm gonna surprise you even 
more this year, so look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Inari-cha~n! You looked so cool in the 
Tokyo Daishoten~! Make sure to drop by our 
shop next time!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a lot, ma'am! Next time, I'll bring 
the folks from Tracen Academy with me and 
drop by again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Everyone's expecting a lot from 
me, so it really gets me focused.
choice_data_list:
I have to live up to the cheers in this 
Senior Year.

I have to live up to the cheers in this 
Senior Year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'm itching for a massive brawl 
so bad I can hardly stand it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops. Looks like it's our turn to pray. 
What're you gonna wish for, Boss?
choice_data_list: Wishing good health upon Inari One
The fulfillment of our greatest wish.
The fulfillment of our greatest wish.
Evil spirits, begone!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops. Looks like it's our turn to pray. 
What're you gonna wish for, Big Sis?
choice_data_list: Wishing good health upon Inari One
The fulfillment of our greatest wish.
The fulfillment of our greatest wish.
Evil spirits, begone!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You're prayin' for my health, 
Boss? But if you do that, who's gonna pray 
for your own health, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You're prayin' for my health, 
Sis? But if you do that, who's gonna pray 
for your own health, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll go ahead and offer up a prayer 
for you, Boss. That makes us even!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll go ahead and offer up a prayer 
for you, Sis. That makes us even!

And so, Inari One and I prayed for each 
other's continued good health—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's true. The "top" we're aiming 
for is a massive ambition! It's not 
something that comes easy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why the two of us gotta 
stand side by side and pray together!"

And so, Inari One and I prayed for the 
fulfillment of our great ambition—to reach 
the "top" in the Senior Class as well—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! What's with that?! Giving me my 
first laugh of the year? Well, you got me 
good!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, making sure bad vibes don't gather 
around is definitely important too. All 
right, let's go pray for some evil 
warding!

And so, Inari One and I prayed together to 
ward off evil spirits—

After finishing our Hatsumode visit, we 
stopped by the shopping district, where 
everyone was happily chatting over food 
and drinks at outdoor seating.

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, here they come! Inari-chan and her 
Trainer! Yo! Our very own Oi Boss!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Inari-neesan! You haven't had lunch yet, 
right? Let's eat together over here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I was just gettin' hungry! Much 
obliged!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna head over that way for a bit. 
There's a whole feast laid out, so go 
ahead and dig in yourself, Boss!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I will.
Yeah, maybe I will.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna head over that way for a bit. 
There's a whole feast laid out, so go 
ahead and dig in yourself, Big Sis!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I will.
Yeah, maybe I will.

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
We were just talking about Inari-chan! 
Saying how cool she was in the Tokyo 
Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan, Inari-chan! Did you see this 
magazine?! What they wrote is so 
exciting~!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
"Inari One declares all-out rampage in the 
Senior class! Aiming for Umamusume of the 
Year, no less! Clash with Oguri Cap and 
others inevitable!?" it says!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
"They're gonna air a review show for last 
year's races after this, too! We were just 
talkin' about how we should all watch it 
together on TV!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
You're definitely gonna get featured too, 
Big Sis! After making such a huge scene 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'd be a bit embarrassed if that 
happened! Sure hope they catch my stylish 
side, though!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: —Yo, Trainer. Happy New Year.
choice_data_list:
Boss! Thank you for all your help this 
past year!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that's my line. ...Thanks to you and 
Inari, Trainer, everyone on my team is 
totally fired up.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna throw a massive festival at 
Ohi again this year," he says with that 
wild glint in his eye. It really takes a 
toll on this old body of mine, I tell ya. 
Confound it all—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
...Make yourself at home too, Trainer. 
Everyone's taken a big shine to you, not 
just Inari.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.text:
And so, carried along by the flow, I 
enjoyed sharing food and having a fun time 
with the townspeople—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—From here on out, let's look back at 
last year's thrilling Twinkle Series 
alongside race footage!”

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text: It's started! It's finally started!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
""The person indispensable to any 
discussion of last year is none other than 
her! The "Monster," Oguri Cap! She 
produced countless legendary races!""

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't she the hottest Umamusume right 
now? I became a total fan myself ever 
since I saw her run in person at the 
racetrack!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Last year's Arima Kinen saw a fierce, 
breathtaking clash against the 'White 
Lightning,' Tamamo Cross!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘Truly the race of the century! That's 
what that was. It was such a nail-biting, 
magnificent race that makes you wonder if 
we'll ever see its like again!’"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—Leading up to this Arima Kinen, Oguri 
Cap also ran alongside Tamamo Cross in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)—”

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
“—Feels like everyone's only talking about 
the Arima Kinen. Won't you talk about 
Inari-chan and the rest?”

In the end, the broadcast concluded after 
using Oguri Cap as a reference to look 
back on last year's Central graded 
races...

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
—Sheesh, in the end it's all about the 
Central. Even after the Tokyo Daishoten 
and Japan Dirt Derby got everyone so hyped 
up, too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't accept this! We had such an 
amazing race with Big Sis...! And they 
didn't even mention it...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Get outta here!!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text: I-Inari-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up, listen up! Why the long faces, 
everybody?! That's no way to kick off the 
new year!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Still, Big Sis...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Did you forget? This year, Inari One will 
represent the local Umamusume and pick a 
big, flashy fight against the Central 
powerhouses!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win Umamusume of the Year and teach 
'em a lesson! That regional races, 
regional-born Umamusume, and our very 
souls are—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just how incredible it is, enough to rival 
the Central!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's why— today's celebration is to hype 
us up! Let's all party loud and laugh 
together!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's a festival, a festival--!!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
...Hell yeah! Inari-chan's here with us 
today! No time to be moping around with a 
gloomy face!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan is giving it her all, so we 
can't just sit around and whine about it!

Thanks to Inari One's powerful words, the 
downtown folks regained their spirits, and 
afterwards, everyone had a great time 
partying together—

Carrying a bunch of souvenirs given by the 
downtown locals, on the way back to the 
Academy—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Boss. Thanks for hangin' out with me 
today. I had a real blast thanks to you.
choice_data_list:
Everyone seemed really happy to talk with 
you, Inari.

Everyone seemed really happy to talk with 
you, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sis. Thanks for hanging out with me 
today. I had a lot of fun because of you.
choice_data_list:
Everyone seemed really happy to talk with 
you, Inari.

Everyone seemed really happy to talk with 
you, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Ain't no way I'm losing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I have to get results no matter what... 
and reach the 'top', becoming 'Umamusume 
of the Year'."
choice_data_list: Inari—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In the Japan Dirt Derby and the Tokyo 
Daishoten, the boss and the crew answered 
me with the greatest races of all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"The folks around here, everyone in the 
downtown area... they're all counting on 
me to do well."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"—It's right here inside me. The burning 
passion I got from everyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I wanna... answer their hopes...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm never gonna let the feelings everyone 
gave me go to waste! That's why—
choice_data_list:
Let's definitely become 'Horse Girl of the 
Year.'

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Big Sis—

The deep affection for the folks back home 
that Inari One holds inside. The powerful 
sense of duty born from it. I want to 
shoulder that burden alongside her.
Because—
choice_data_list: We're partners, aren't we?
We're partners, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, man. Boss always pulls off 
something amazing right when it counts the 
most.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, man. Big sis always pulls 
off something amazing right when it counts 
the most.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Countin' on you, partner.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Run through this path of grand brawls... 
alongside me!

With renewed determination— The Senior 
Year's massive brawl begins...!
